info.title: Quirenote API
info.description: Derived from infra/template-user.yaml and the handlers’ own response constants by infra/src/openapi.ts. Do not edit: run `pnpm openapi` and commit the result. These are the HANDLERS’ answers. API Gateway answers ahead of them too and those are not described here: 401 for a token the JWT authorizer refuses, which is the commonest admin failure once an access token passes its hour, and 429 from the per-route throttle.

tags.name: applications
tags.description: The sign-up application, which an approval turns into an account.

tags.name: admin
tags.description: The super-admin’s: the applications and their rulings, and the price archive’s diagnosis and repairs.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: The relay: sign-in by password, passkey or Google, the session’s refresh and sign-out, sign-out everywhere, and the account’s passkeys.

tags.name: view
tags.description: The derived reads: the portfolio for six periods, the yield curve, the Balances table and a day’s quotes.

tags.name: mutations
tags.description: The portfolio’s write, as ordered ops under one precondition.

tags.name: state
tags.description: The raw export of the stored portfolio.

tags.name: imports
tags.description: The staged import: a dataset too large for one transaction, in parts that one commit moves.

tags.name: me
tags.description: The caller’s own account and what it holds, read by the screens that show it, its settings, written as a merge patch, and its acceptance of the terms of use.
